name: mm_mallinfo

provenance.source: Exact raw Thumb audit with startup-copy mapping and Lua/native callsite verification

notes: struct mallinfo mm_mallinfo(heap): AAPCS returns the 7-word record through the hidden r0 pointer, heap in r1. Asserts against "../../nuttx/mm/mm_heap/mm_mallinfo.c"; walks the heap through mm_foreach 0xc34f028 (heap lock held) with per-node callback 0xc347d0c filling ordblks/aordblks/mxordblk/uordblks/fordblks. mm_malloc 0xc35056c calls it on its failure path before _assert(mm_malloc.c, 417, "panic"), so mxordblk is the exact quantity a request is matched against. The ensemble candidate heap_mallinfo 0xc3608b8 is a different function (vtable store + 0xc35e358) and is NOT this symbol. Independently recovered for the native static test ABI; device NOT_PROBED. No general SDK callable approval.
